values.note: Standard non-electric $20, standard electric $25 (2026, unchanged 2024-2028). The rate table also prices premium non-electric $24 and premium electric $29, but no site in the catalog is typed premium. Extra vehicles $5.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232127/rates (Peak Season 2026-03-31 to 2026-10-31: STANDARD NONELECTRIC $20, STANDARD ELECTRIC $25, PREMIUM ELECTRIC SITE $29) + catalog site types, read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog for 232127 (5 bookable STANDARD ELECTRIC sites list 50 or 50/30-amp, 20 list 20-amp, 2 list 15-amp; no site lists water or sewer), read 2026-10-20

values.note: recreation.gov lists 53 bookable RV sites (27 standard electric, 26 standard non-electric) besides 32 walk-to tent sites, 13 electric cabins and a group picnic area. Max vehicle lengths run 30-60 ft; 3 pull-throughs, the rest back-in.

sites.source: recreation.gov catalog for 232127 (site types, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry; host sites left out), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Showers, flush toilets and water are seasonal.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232127 (Facilities: 'Accessible flush and vault toilets, as well as showers and drinking water are provided'; amenities 'Dump Station', 'Flush Toilets (Seasonal)', 'Showers (Seasonal)', 'Water (Seasonal)'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 'Some sites are available on a first-come, first-served basis'; walk-ups pay by fee envelope within 30 minutes of arrival. Holiday weekends need 3 nights. 14 nights in any rolling 30 days.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232127 (Facilities description; notices; facility_rules minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxStay 14 per rolling 30 days), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed $20-25 fees, 50-amp electric (5 sites; most are 20-amp, no water/sewer at sites), reservable on rec.gov. Added 53 RV sites to 60 ft with 3 pull-throughs, showers/flush+vault toilets/water/dump (seasonal), some FCFS sites, 3-night holiday minimum, 14-night max. Not stated: campground season (rate season only; cabins year-round), booking window; --AWH note untouched.
